mapper.select: SELECT u.user_seq, u.user_id, u.user_name, u.password_hash, u.org_seq, u.email, u.phone, u.dept_name, u.position_name, u.status, u.approval_limit, u.login_fail_count, u.locked_until, u.last_login_at, u.password_changed_at, u.must_change_password, u.use_yn, -- 한 번도 로그인한 적 없는 계정은 만든 시각으로 휴면을 판정한다 u.created_at, o.org_id, o.org_name, o.org_type FROM tb_user u JOIN tb_org o ON o.org_seq = u.org_seq WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT r.role_id FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = ur.role_seq WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq} ORDER BY r.sort_order
SELECT r.role_name FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = ur.role_seq WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq} ORDER BY r.sort_order

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_id, rp.action_code, r.role_id, p.module_code, COALESCE(rp.data_scope, r.default_data_scope) AS effective_data_scope FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = ur.role_seq AND r.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN tb_role_permission rp ON rp.role_seq = r.role_seq JOIN tb_permission p ON p.perm_seq = rp.perm_seq AND p.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq}

WITH RECURSIVE seed AS ( -- 소속 조직 SELECT u.org_seq, 'Y'::char(1) AS include_child_yn FROM tb_user u WHERE u.user_seq = #{userSeq} AND u.org_seq IS NOT NULL UNION -- 역할에 따라붙은 조직 범위 SELECT s.org_seq, s.include_child_yn FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = ur.role_seq AND r.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN tb_role_org_scope s ON s.role_seq = r.role_seq WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq} ), tree AS ( SELECT o.org_seq, seed.include_child_yn FROM seed JOIN tb_org o ON o.org_seq = seed.org_seq UNION SELECT child.org_seq, tree.include_child_yn FROM tree JOIN tb_org child ON child.parent_seq = tree.org_seq WHERE tree.include_child_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT org_seq FROM tree

SELECT pol.policy_seq, pol.policy_id, pol.policy_name, pol.role_seq, pol.perm_seq, pol.policy_type, pol.enforce_level, pol.condition_expr, pol.target_field, pol.message, pol.alt_process, pol.limit_amount, pol.limit_qty, pol.remark, pol.use_yn, r.role_id, r.role_name, pm.perm_id, pm.perm_name FROM tb_user_role ur JOIN tb_role r ON r.role_seq = ur.role_seq AND r.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN tb_policy pol ON pol.role_seq = r.role_seq AND pol.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN tb_permission pm ON pm.perm_seq = pol.perm_seq WHERE ur.user_seq = #{userSeq} ORDER BY pol.policy_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_user SET login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1, updated_by = 'system', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}
UPDATE tb_user SET status = 'LOCKED', locked_until = NULL, updated_by = 'system', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}
UPDATE tb_user SET locked_until = #{until}, updated_by = 'system', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}
UPDATE tb_user SET status = 'DORMANT', updated_by = 'system', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND COALESCE(last_login_at, created_at) < #{threshold}
UPDATE tb_user SET status = 'DORMANT', updated_by = 'system', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND use_yn = 'Y' AND COALESCE(last_login_at, created_at) < #{threshold}
UPDATE tb_user SET login_fail_count = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'system', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}

UPDATE tb_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, password_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, must_change_password = 'N', login_fail_count = 0, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_seq = #{userSeq}
